Terms & conditions

  • This offer is only valid for new customers, who have applied digitally for the specific offer
  • This offer is not valid for customers who have an existing Emirates NBD Card and apply for a second card
  • This offer will be valid upon activation and after the first purchase of any amount is made within the first month
  • The Noon voucher code will be sent to the customer’s registered email address and can be redeemed online only
  • The value of the voucher will depend on card applied for and card eligibility:
    •  250 Noon voucher: Diners Credit Card, Diners Charge Card, dnata Mastercard Platinum, Go4it Gold, Go4it Platinum, Lulu 247 Titanium Mastercard, Lulu 247 Platinum Mastercard, Manchester United Credit Card, Manchester United Prepaid Credit Card, Mastercard Platinum, Mastercard Titanium, U By Emaar Visa Family, VISA Platinum, U By Emaar Visa Signature, VISA Flexi Credit Card, Diners Bundle Credit Card
    •  400 Noon voucher: dnata World Credit Card, Marriott Bonvoy World Mastercard, U By Emaar Visa Infinite, VISA Infinite Credit Card, VISA Skywards Infinite Credit Card, Etihad Guest Visa Elevate Credit Card, Etihad Guest Visa Inspire Credit Card
  • All applications are subject to approval at sole and absolute discretion of Emirates NBD
  • Please read the Emirates NBD terms and conditions before you apply for the card
  • This offer is not valid in conjunction with any other promotion
  • Offer is not valid for any supplementary cards
  • Eligible Customers will receive the voucher within 45 days after the first statement
  • The voucher amount can be redeemed on Noon/Noon daily website or app
  • The voucher will be valid for 1 time redemption per user
  • The voucher cannot be reversed once the credit has been redeemed by a Customer on any of the platforms
  • If you have more than one eligible voucher applied to your account when you place an order, the vouchers are redeemed in order of expiry date, with the voucher expiring the earliest redeemed first
  • The vouchers cannot be redeemed in conjunction with any other offer
